lines: The star that drifts far away
The future you choose, the path you desire
On this planet you were brought to
To the glittering scenery far beyond
If only we could dive into it
Rather than flee, we move forward
If that is what you have chosen
Not an image drawn by someone else
Not a stage set by another
But the story we create ourselves
We will never let anyone be alone
Until the blade hidden in your chest
We are not puppets to be controlled
It is your world, it is your future
In the cockpit that we boarded
The crying you are no longer there
Somehow you have grown so strong
There is no answer to be found
At a speed no one can catch
Kicking the ground, soaring into the sky
You will change it with your own hands
For being born on this planet
For continuing to live in this world
May you come to love all of it
